product_updates.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
product_updates.content: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

product_updates.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
product_updates.content: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

product_updates.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
product_updates.content: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

product_updates.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
product_updates.content: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

product_updates.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
product_updates.content: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.

product_updates.title: Meeting note-taker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers
product_updates.content: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month.

product_updates.title: The US is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
product_updates.content: The U.S. is shutting out more foreign-made drones and robots. China’s scale means the global competition may simply move elsewhere.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Think twice before installing this device promising free movies
technical_breakthroughs.content: In exchange for free stuff, devices make home connections part of a proxy network.
